Return only JSON with replacement entries keyed by stage and exact claim/inquiry ID; include new text and exact literal source quotes for each referenced item. evidence.quote: Were you approached by community and/or political party representatives?

claims.text: The stem asks whether community and/or political party representatives approached the interviewer, so the item records contact of the field team rather than the respondent's partisanship or perceived influence.

evidence.quote: Were you physically threatened during the interview?

claims.text: The item records a physically threatened experience during the interview encounter, so it does not record threats reported by the respondent or events in the enumeration area.
The interviewer rates the respondent's attitude during the interview on a three-way scale, so the item records demeanour in one encounter rather than a validated measure of truthful answers.

claims.text: Q106C records an interviewer-side event of being approached by representatives, while Q97 records the respondent's attributed sender of the survey; pairing them separates observed field contact from the respondent's sponsorship belief, since an approach by representatives need not mean the respondent names a party as sender, and losing Q97 would leave the approach with no counterpart attribution.

evidence.quote: Did you feel threatened during the interview?
